references.text: Here the Lord explains why he allowed some nations to remain – to test Israel and see if they would follow his ways.
The Lord allowed these nations to remain and did not drive them out at once, nor did he hand them over into Joshua's control.
Continuation of the same theme – the nations were left behind to test whether Israel would keep the Lord's commands.
God tested Israel in the wilderness to know what was in their hearts, whether they would keep his commands.
The Lord led Israel through trials to test them and ultimately do good to them.
The Lord said he would drive out the nations little by little, not all at once in a single year, so that the land would not become desolate.
Joshua warns that the remaining nations will become a snare and trap for Israel if they mix with them.
